structured_output.what_is_happening: "Bob's Bear" is a 40-minute-old token. Its pool was created directly on PumpSwap at 07:32 UTC. It did not start on the pump.fun bonding curve: migrated_unix=0, launchpad and deploy platform unknown. Price has roughly doubled in the last hour to about $46-48k market cap, on about $390k of 1h volume (6x turnover). The trade flow looks manufactured. GeckoTerminal shows 3,314 buys and 2,316 sells in 1h but only 113 unique sellers, and the 5m buy and sell counts are almost equal (286/277). Together that suggests bot churn or wash volume, not organic demand. 1,122 unique buyers against 113 sellers fits a wallet-spray or airdrop-style buy pattern. The pool LP is 0% locked or burned, and RugCheck flags "Large Amount of LP Unlocked" and "Low amount of LP Providers", so whoever seeded the pool can withdraw it. One wallet holds 10.02%, and GMGN counts it as dev/team and sniper holdings. GMGN also flags 23 bundler wallets. The creator wallet shows balance 0 and "creator_close". The only project text is a Su Shi poem line (明月几时有，把酒问青天). There are no socials, website or DexScreener profile, and I found no mentions anywhere.

The Chinese poem description hints at a launch aimed at Chinese-speaking traders, but it carries no story.

There are no socials and I found no web mentions.
